snippet.title: Sunset Survival: Miami - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4747280/Sunset_Survival_Miami/

Gear up, get out, and survive the neon-soaked apocalypse. Sunset Survival: Miami is a top-down PvE extraction shooter. Raid a mutant-infested Miami for vital supplies, blast your way through enemy hordes, upgrade your base, and unlock powerful skills. Can you make it out alive?

FEATURES
-Explore ruined Miami streets and dangerous interiors, 
  including bars, hotels, nightclubs, and more.
- Fight against diverse mutant enemies.
- Build and improve your home base.
- Craft new items.
- Massive arsenal of different firearms and melee weapons.
- Upgrade your stats and unlock new skills.
- Dynamic weather and day and night cycle.
- Complete quests and earn rewards.
